content.text: Small requests go through now. The earlier failure was the agent's 32768 max-token request, so I'll test that size.

input.command: cd ~/.dsh && KEY=$(grep -A3 -i 'MYLYNX_API_KEY' .credentials.yaml | grep -oE '(sk|key)[-_A-Za-z0-9]+' | head -1); [ -z "$KEY" ] && KEY=$(grep -A3 -i 'MYLYNX_API_KEY' .credentials.yaml | sed -n 's/.*: *//p' | tail -1 | tr -d "\"' "); curl -s -m 90 http://localhost:20128/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"lynx harness","max_tokens":32768,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say OK"}]}' | head -c 400
input.description: Test OmniRoute with the agent's max-token size
